title: University Library Traffic Analysis
scenario: Calculate how many students were in the library at any given timestamp.
tableSchema: logins (user_id INT, enter_t TIMESTAMP, exit_t TIMESTAMP)
hint: Union entry and exit events and take a running sum of +1/-1.
correctQuery: SELECT ts, SUM(event_type) OVER(ORDER BY ts) as current_occupancy FROM (SELECT enter_t as ts, 1 as event_type FROM logins UNION ALL SELECT exit_t as ts, -1 as event_type FROM logins) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logins (user_id INT, enter_t TIMESTAMP, exit_t TIMESTAMP);
